findings.location: Header brand title 'Books to Scrape' and blue text links (e.g., category list and book titles)
findings.issue: The primary blue text color (approximately #337ab7) on a white background fails WCAG AA 4.5:1 contrast requirements for normal text, measuring at approximately 3.4:1.
findings.user_impact: Users with low vision or color vision deficiencies, as well as users in high-glare outdoor environments, will find it difficult to read navigation categories, product titles, and the main site brand.
findings.recommendation: Replace the primary blue color with a darker shade such as #225c87 or #1b517e, ensuring a minimum contrast ratio of 4.5:1 against the white background.

findings.location: Product grid book titles (e.g., 'Full Moon over Noah\'s ...', 'Neither Here nor There: ...')
findings.issue: Book titles are aggressively truncated with ellipsis (...) after a very short character count to enforce single-line alignment.
findings.user_impact: Shoppers cannot read full book titles from the catalog view, which increases interaction cost as they must hover or click each detail page to see what the book actually is.
findings.recommendation: Allow titles to wrap up to 2 lines. Use CSS Grid or Flexbox alignment ('align-items: stretch' and 'margin-top: auto' on the buttons) to ensure 'Add to basket' buttons remain perfectly aligned horizontally across rows regardless of title length.

findings.issue: A flat list of over 40 book categories is presented with extremely tight vertical spacing and no grouping, creating a dense 'wall of text'.
findings.user_impact: High cognitive load makes it extremely tedious and frustrating for users to scan, find, or filter by specific genres.
findings.recommendation: Group the genres into collapsible parent categories (e.g., 'Fiction', 'Non-Fiction', 'Academic') and increase the vertical padding of list items to at least 8px to improve scan-ability and touch-target sizes.
